The Slutsky Decomposition

This scene splits a price rise into two effects to see why demand falls.

A price change brings two effects at once. The substitution effect pushes you away from the pricier good. The income effect comes from feeling poorer than before. You can compensate by the old bundle or by the old utility. The two ways split the formula below differently.

For example, if 🍎 apples get pricier, switching to 🍌 bananas is the substitution effect. If you then buy less fruit overall because 💰 money feels tight, that is the income effect.
